page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top (IN PSALM. LXXXIIII). Main text in one column with a centred heading VERSVS III. and a verse block in italic; no margin notes; no footer text.

main_text.p: templum spiritus sancti, qui est in vobis, & quem habetis a Deo, neq; esse vestri iuris? 1 Cor. 6. 17. 19. Ite, Precor igitur vos, fratres, per miserationes Dei, ut sistatis corpora vestra hostiam viuam, sanctam, acceptam Deo, rationalem illum cultum vestrum, Rom. 12. 1. & Psal. 50.
main_text.head: VERSVS III.

p.i: Etiam passer invenit domum, & hirundo nidum sibi, in quo reponat pullos suos: o altaria tua, armipotens Ichouah, rex mi, & Deus mi.

main_text.p: Alterum argumentum a disparatorum trifti collatione ducitur.
Quis non intelligat etiam abiectissimarum avicularum, non debere esse meliore conditionem, quam hominis fidelis: verbi gratia, quàm mea sit fors.

Atqui & passerculis & hirundinibus niduli diuinitus obtingunt, in quibus tutò collocant suam pulliciem. At lucet etiam hac in parte admirabilis Dei prouidentia, homine & animalia feruas, alès & custodies.
Quis igitur ambigat, no debere mea, qui atria Dei frequentare, qui altare Dei circùdare, & debitû Deo cultû praestare cupio, conditionem deteriorem esse?

page.notes: Catchword "Maio-" is the start of the next page's word, printed at lower right. The first paragraph is a continuation from the previous page. Running head and page number read as printed; the page number "184" is at the top left, partly blurred. Some letters in the body are doubtful due to ink and paper wear, notably "abiectissimarum", "pulliciem", "feruas" and "alès": these may be misprinted or misread and are not marked, as I could not verify them letter by letter with certainty. Heading "VERSVS III." is set in spaced capitals, centred. The Latin verse lines are italic. Reference marks such as "1 Cor." are printed in the margin area but reproduced as in running text.
